title: C1463B — Power steering control module (PSCM)
introduction:
The power steering control module calculates steering assistance and commands the assist motor. This particular connector reference identifies a ground return and a fused feed. I treat it as an electrical passport: it identifies the connections, but it cannot certify the controller’s health.

Start with CNumber, Description and the housing Color entry, then compare the illustration and follow each cavity label into the assignment table. Preserve the repeated feed entries without choosing a wire color or assuming an extra cavity. The cavity-count discrepancy needs review. This page covers identification; access, viewing-side confirmation, probing, wire selection and replacement require matching service information. The gauge convention and Size and Used codes are unexplained.
